description: This file defines the Vtiger_ModuleBasic class, providing an API to manage and manipulate CRM modules within the vtiger CRM system. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting modules, managing related database tables, and configuring module access and sharing settings.

classes.name: Vtiger_ModuleBasic
classes.description: A class providing an API to manage vtiger CRM modules, including creation, update, deletion, configuration, and database schema management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for initializing a Vtiger_ModuleBasic object.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes module properties from a provided values map.

methods.name: initialize2
methods.description: Loads additional entity-related schema information for the module.

methods.name: __getUniqueId
methods.description: Generates a new unique tab ID for the module.

methods.name: __getNextSequence
methods.description: Determines the next tab sequence value.

methods.name: __handleVtigerCoreSchemaChanges
methods.description: Handles core schema changes for the module, such as adding columns.

methods.name: __create
methods.description: Creates a new module entry in the database, setting up necessary schema and configuration.

methods.name: __update
methods.description: Updates an existing module (placeholder for update logic).

methods.name: __delete
methods.description: Deletes a module and associated related data.

methods.name: __updateVersion
methods.description: Updates the version information for the module in the database.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the module, creating or updating as needed.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the module and cleans up related data and configurations.

methods.name: initTables
methods.description: Initializes essential database tables for the module.

methods.name: setEntityIdentifier
methods.description: Sets the entity identifier field for the module.

methods.name: unsetEntityIdentifier
methods.description: Removes entity identifier configuration from the database.

methods.name: deleteRelatedLists
methods.description: Deletes related list entries for the module.

methods.name: deleteLinks
methods.description: Deletes link configurations for the module.

methods.name: setDefaultSharing
methods.description: Sets default sharing permissions for the module.

methods.name: allowSharing
methods.description: Enables sharing for the module.

methods.name: disallowSharing
methods.description: Disables sharing for the module.

methods.name: enableTools
methods.description: Enables specified tools for the module (e.g., Import, Export).

methods.name: disableTools
methods.description: Disables specified tools for the module.

methods.name: addBlock
methods.description: Adds a block to the module.

methods.name: addFilter
methods.description: Adds a filter to the module.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Retrieves all fields for the module or a specific block.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages using the utility class.

methods.name: syncfile
methods.description: Synchronizes module data to the tab data flat file.
